analysis.headline: Putin praises Elon Musk as a genius after satellite talks
analysis.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin praised Elon Musk after satellite talks with the SpaceX boss, with outlets quoting him calling Musk either a 'real genius' or 'truly a genius.' Putin said the two are in close contact, reportedly regarding Rassvet, described as Russia's Starlink-like satellite connectivity project.
